messages:
Maya (Design): quick mock — compact spend row with a small download area pinned next to the scope toggle. keeps invoice action visible.
Eric (PM): good. finance needs Download to be obvious. mobile behavior?
Maya (Design): mobile -> full-width Invoice CTA in header. desktop -> small icon + label near scope.
Sam (FE): ok. note: collapsing rail at <980px to icon+label to save width.
Lina (Eng): virtualization required if rows >1000. only stick one element to avoid reflow issues.
Olivia (Content): CTA copy: "Download invoice (PDF/CSV)"; aria: "Download invoice for selected scope and period".
Eric (PM): acceptance for this sprint: invoice within two tab stops of scope toggle, mobile header CTA present, and ARIA label implemented.
Maya (Design): action items: update Figma with collapsed rail variant and aria notes.
Sam (FE): Ill draft component props and keyboard flow.
Lina (Eng): Ill add virtualization plan and confirm backend flag for fiat lazy-load.
ui-bot: Reminder: design review tomorrow 11:00 — add updated mock to agenda.
